summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 2, best). It has the six labelled vertices A, B, C, D, E, G with the solid edges B-E, A-E, E-C, E-D, C-D, and A-B, plus the dashed edges A-G and G-D and solid horizontal overhangs at G and D. The Critic scored v2 at 0.9 with no issues and must_repair=false, and all topology edges were verified.
